title: Mike and Cellphone
statementMd:
While swimming at the beach, Mike has accidentally dropped his cellphone into the water. There was no worry as he bought a cheap replacement phone with an old-fashioned keyboard. The keyboard has only ten digital equal-sized keys, located in the following way:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5c60ed3976147c1c90119a9ead7181e750377a9b.png)

Together with his old phone, he lost all his contacts and now he can only remember the way his fingers moved when he put some number in. One can formally consider *finger movements* as a sequence of vectors connecting centers of keys pressed consecutively to put in a number. For example, the finger movements for number "586" are the same as finger movements for number "253":

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/869ec2acf214a5bb662b3b299fd47a1edc8ea8c7.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf4ddb7411bfe5e7c5fea0cb7a2c8af92ad73a9e.png)

Mike has already put in a number by his "finger memory" and started calling it, so he is now worrying, can he be sure that he is calling the correct number? In other words, is there any other number, that has the same finger movements?

## Input

The first line of the input contains the only integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 9$) — the number of digits in the phone number that Mike put in.

The second line contains the string consisting of $*n*$ digits (characters from '`0`' to '`9`') representing the number that Mike put in.

## Output

If there is no other phone number with the same finger movements and Mike can be sure he is calling the correct number, print "`YES`" (without quotes) in the only line.

Otherwise print "`NO`" (without quotes) in the first line.

## Note

You can find the picture clarifying the first sample case in the statement above.
statementZhMd:
在海边游泳时，迈克不小心把手机掉进了水里。不过他并不担心，因为他买了一部带有老式键盘的廉价替代手机。这个键盘只有十个大小相同的数字按键，排列如下：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5c60ed3976147c1c90119a9ead7181e750377a9b.png)

他的旧手机也丢失了，所有联系人都没有了。现在，他只能记住输入某个号码时手指移动的方式。形式化地说，可以将*手指移动*看作一个向量序列，其中每个向量连接连续按下的按键的中心，用于输入一个号码。例如，号码 "586" 的手指移动方式与号码 "253" 的相同：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/869ec2acf214a5bb662b3b299fd47a1edc8ea8c7.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cf4ddb7411bfe5e7c5fea0cb7a2c8af92ad73a9e.png)

迈克已经凭借“手指记忆”输入了一个号码，并开始拨打它。现在他担心，自己能否确定拨打的是正确的号码？换句话说，是否存在另一个具有相同手指移动方式的号码？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含唯一的整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 9$）——迈克输入的电话号码的位数。

第二行包含一个由 $*n*$ 个数字组成的字符串（字符为 '`0`' 至 '`9`'），表示迈克输入的号码。

## 输出格式

如果不存在具有相同手指移动方式的其他电话号码，迈克可以确定自己拨打的是正确号码，则在唯一一行中输出 "`YES`"（不含引号）。

否则，在第一行中输出 "`NO`"（不含引号）。

## 说明

题目描述上方的图片展示了第一个样例的具体情况。
